item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be relatively humid, and hot during the day over the region. It will bring a few showers to Guangdong towards the weekend. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening slightly early next week, showers will ease off and the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong in the middle to latter parts of next week.
